jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Quest Analytics®, we build technology that helps health plans navigate some of the most complex challenges in healthcare. We’re searching for a Software Engineer to help us build and scale our platform.

You’ll own the features you build, from first requirements conversation through deployment, working alongside product managers, designers, architects, and DevOps engineers. Your input on design and architecture will carry real weight, and the decisions you help make will shape our current offerings, and new product lines as we grow.

Our engineering teams value high-quality code, open collaboration, and creative problem solving. We review each other’s work with constructive feedback, communicate early about blockers and risks, and take ownership of our results. We also embrace new technology, including AI-powered tools, to improve both the quality and the speed of what we deliver, and you’ll have a hand in shaping how our teams use them.

What you'll do

  • Take part in the full development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design through implementation, testing, and deployment.

  • Partner with product managers, designers, architects, and DevOps engineers to turn requirements into working software.

  • Own your project timelines and deliverables, flag blockers and risks early so your team can help.

  • Contribute to the design and architecture of new and existing products and features.

  • Write clean, efficient, maintainable code built for performance and scalability.

  • Give constructive feedback in code reviews and hold your work to team coding standards.

  • Use AI-powered tools in your daily work to improve the quality and speed of development and help shape how the team adopts them.

  • Make day-to-day technical decisions within established patterns, and bring larger choices, like major frameworks or design patterns, to your manager.

  • Handle confidential information with care, especially protected health information (PHI), and follow Quest Analytics HIPAA Privacy and Security Practices.

  • Join training and mentoring programs, as a learner or as a guide.

What you'll need

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience.

  • Three to five years of backend development with Microsoft’s .NET Framework and C# at a commercial SaaS company, ideally working with large data sets.

  • Proficiency in SQL Server and in designing, building, and consuming REST APIs.

  • Snowflake, Databricks, or general data platform experience for large data processing.

  • Experience building on Azure cloud services, including Azure Functions, Event Grid, and Service Bus, plus familiarity with Blob Storage or AWS Lambda, EventBridge, SNS, or SQS.

  • Experience with React or a comparable modern JavaScript framework for front-end work.

  • Familiarity with unit testing (XUnit preferred) and SOLID principles.

  • Source control experience with Git.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, and a collaborative, team-oriented approach to your work.

  • Experience multiplying your output with AI development tools.

Compensation

Additional Information

About Quest Analytics

For more than 20 years, we’ve been improving provider network management one groundbreaking innovation at a time. 90% of America’s health plans use our tools, including the eight largest in the nation. Achieve your personal quest to build a great career here.

What you’ll appreciate:

•Workplace flexibility – you choose between remote, hybrid or in-office

•Affordable employee medical, dental and vision plans with low employee cost

•401k Matching

•Wellness benefits

•Competitive salary and success sharing bonus

•Flexible vacation, plus sick time and holidays

•An entrepreneurial culture that won’t limit you to a job description

•Being listened to, valued, appreciated -- and having your contributions rewarded

•Enjoying your work each day with a great group of people

Apply TODAY!

careers.questanalytics.com

Next Steps
After you apply, you will receive an email confirming receipt of your application. If your background and experience align with our needs, a member of the Quest Analytics Talent Acquisition team will contact you regarding next steps in the process. Candidates will receive communication throughout the interview process regarding their status and progression.

Interview Process
The interview process may vary by role but typically includes:

  • Recruiter Video Interview
  • Video Interview with the Hiring Manager
  • Team and/or Panel Interview(s)
  • Role-Specific Assessment, Presentation, or Case Study (if applicable)
  • Professional Reference Checks via Skill Survey
  • Final Interview with Executive Leadership

Video Camera Usage Policy
Quest Analytics is a remote-first organization that values collaboration, communication, and engagement. To support a connected and productive work environment, candidates are expected to participate in all virtual interviews with their cameras enabled.
Video participation helps create a more interactive interview experience, allows for stronger communication and relationship-building, and supports our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process. Camera usage also serves as an important safeguard against fraudulent applicants, identity misrepresentation, unauthorized participation, and other security risks that have become increasingly common in remote hiring environments.
Candidates who are unable or unwilling to participate on camera during the interview process may not be considered for employment.

Relocation Requirement
While many positions at Quest Analytics are remote, employees are expected to reside in and perform work from the location disclosed during the hiring process. Any relocation must be communicated to and approved by Quest Analytics in advance.
This policy helps ensure compliance with employment and tax regulations, protects company and client data, and reduces risks associated with unauthorized work arrangements and employment misrepresentation.

AI Tools

As part of our hiring process, Quest Analytics may use AI-assisted tools to help screen applications and support interview documentation, including resume-matching software and AI-generated interview summaries. These tools inform but do not replace human judgment; all hiring decisions are made by Quest Analytics team members. If you have questions about our use of AI in hiring, please contact recruiting@questanalytics.com.

**Visa sponsorship is not available at this time.

Preferred work locations are within one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin, or Wyoming.

Quest Analytics provides equal employment opportunities to all people without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, age, disability, sexual orientation or gender identity or expression or any other legally protected category. We are committed to creating and maintaining a workforce environment that is free from any form of discriminations or harassment.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.

Persons with disabilities who anticipate needing accommodations for any part of the application process may contact, in confidence hr@questanalytics.com

NOTE: Staffing agencies, headhunters, recruiters, and/or placement agencies, please do not contact our hiring managers directly. We are not currently working with additional outside agencies at this time.

Any job posting displayed on websites other than questanalytics.com or jobs.lever.co/questanalytics/ may be out of date, inaccurate and unavailable

RECRUITMENT FRAUD ALERT

We understand that some individuals have recently been impersonating recruiters from Quest Analytics® and soliciting fake job opportunities. We urge you not to disclose any personal or financial information to them. We use only our official website (https://questanalytics.com), email domain (@questanalytics.com), and verified social media accounts to communicate with candidates. If you suspect fraudulent behavior, please report it to us at infosec@questanalytics.com. We appreciate your interest in working with us.

To learn more: https://questanalytics.com/news/recruitment-fraud-alert/

jobs.title: Staff Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Help the world move AI.

At Kong, we're building the connectivity layer that brings AI, APIs, and applications together. Our work helps organizations innovate faster, more securely, and more efficiently.

We're looking for people who think boldly, lead with purpose, and want to make an impact. If you're ready to take on meaningful challenges, do work that matters, and help build what comes next for technology, we'd love to meet you.

About the Role:

Every company is racing to connect AI agents and LLMs to its APIs, data, and systems, securely and at scale. Kong sits at the intersection of API management and AI connectivity, and as a Staff Solutions Engineer you’ll be the person who makes that story real for customers. You won’t just be selling a platform. You’ll be a trusted technical advisor, partnering with Account Executives to lead the technical sale with enterprise and strategic customers as they architect secure, scalable API ecosystems and move into the agentic AI era.

What You’ll Do:

  • Help customers understand the value of Kong’s API and AI connectivity platform, including AI Gateway, API Gateway, MCP, event streaming, and integration.

  • Shape how organizations connect AI agents and LLMs to their APIs, data, and business systems, with the right security, governance, cost control, and observability.

  • Run discovery conversations and map customer requirements to Kong solutions, through architecture design, demos, and proofs of concept, and into production.

  • Lead POCs and technical evaluations from start to finish, owning technical validation and stakeholder alignment.

  • Lead API management and AI governance evaluations, including scoping API and AI use cases, LLM traffic management, and governance requirements.

  • Deliver demos of Kong’s API and AI governance and agentic connectivity capabilities, including MCP governance, semantic caching, prompt guardrails, and shadow AI detection.

  • Run API- and AI-focused Technical Feasibility Workshops (TFWs) to validate Kong’s fit for modern and agentic architectures.

  • Own the technical strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals, from qualification through close.

  • Use AI to create impactful messaging, demos, and solutions tailored to each customer’s business.

  • Ensure customer success across your assigned accounts, onboarding new customers and identifying growth opportunities in existing ones.

  • Mentor and coach junior SEs on technical skills, discovery methods, and deal strategy.

  • Collaborate with Support, Product, and Engineering to advocate for customer needs, and synthesize customer feedback and market signals into actionable roadmap input.

  • Create technical documentation for DevOps, implementation, and services engagements.

  • Drive thought leadership through technical blogs, webinars, and speaking at industry events and conferences such as AWS re:Invent, Google Next, and API & AI Summit.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years of software engineering and/or solutions engineering experience at a SaaS, open source, or enterprise software company.

  • A proven track record owning complex, enterprise-level deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience mentoring or coaching other SEs or technical team members.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or OpenAI Codex (or equivalent).

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms.

  • Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and API security patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS).

  • Working knowledge of AI/LLM architectures, including model routing, rate limiting, semantic caching, and prompt governance.

  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic AI patterns.

  • A solid understanding of cloud computing trends and open source business models.

  • Confidence presenting to and leading discussions with C-level and Director-level executives, product managers, architects, and engineers. You’re a strong listener who can tell the business story and go deep on the technology.

  • Enthusiasm for a high-profile, fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with API gateways, API integration, iPaaS, ETL, or microservices architectures.

  • Experience building with LLMs, agent frameworks, RAG, or MCP servers, or working with AI platforms and model providers.

  • Experience with event streaming, such as Kafka.

  • Familiarity with the major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

#LI-MP1

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer — Full Stack & AI
jobs.description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role:

We are looking for a highly skilled and proactive Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Full Stack & AI) to work directly with business stakeholders, identify operational challenges, and design and implement AI-powered solutions that improve business efficiency.

This is not a traditional software engineering role focused solely on executing predefined technical requirements.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will combine strong full-stack development expertise, practical AI knowledge, and a product-oriented mindset to understand how businesses operate, uncover opportunities for automation, and build solutions that deliver measurable value.

You will take ownership of initiatives from initial discovery and technical design through implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is an experienced engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working directly with stakeholders, asking the right questions, and turning complex business needs into scalable, production-ready applications and intelligent workflows.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate directly with business stakeholders to understand operational processes, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Proactively identify inefficiencies and recommend AI-powered solutions, workflow automation, and application improvements.
  • Design, develop, and deploy full-stack applications that integrate AI capabilities into real business operations.
  • Build and maintain frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and enterprise integrations.
  • Develop AI-powered workflows, intelligent automation solutions, and applications leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Integrate AI models and services into existing business applications and operational systems.
  • Translate ambiguous business requirements into clear technical solutions and actionable implementation plans.
  • Evaluate the feasibility, scalability, reliability, and business impact of proposed solutions.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to prioritize initiatives based on expected value and implementation complexity.
  • Build prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions to validate ideas before broader implementation.
  • Take ownership of technical solutions throughout development, deployment, and production support.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues and continuously improve application performance and reliability.
  • Implement appropriate testing, monitoring, security, and software engineering best practices.
  • Communicate technical decisions, project progress, and business outcomes to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous innovation through AI and automation.

Requirements:

  • Strong professional experience in full-stack software engineering and application development.
  • Proven ability to design, develop, and deploy production-ready applications.
  • Strong understanding of modern frontend and backend architectures.
  • Practical experience integrating AI capabilities into applications or business workflows.
  • Solid understanding of LLMs, AI APIs, and modern AI application development.
  • Experience designing and implementing APIs, integrations, and backend services.
  • Experience with modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node.js, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience working with databases, cloud environments, and distributed applications.
  • Understanding of business processes and operational workflows.
  • Experience gathering requirements and translating business problems into technical solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with ambiguous or evolving requirements.
  • Experience collaborating directly with business stakeholders or customers.
  • Ability to independently own technical initiatives from discovery through delivery.
  • Strong communication skills and a product-oriented mindset.

Must Have:

  • Strong hands-on full-stack engineering experience.
  • Proven experience building and deploying production applications.
  • Practical experience developing or integrating AI-powered applications, workflows, or automation solutions.
  • Strong understanding of LLM capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns.
  • Experience with frontend and backend development.
  • Experience designing and implementing APIs and integrations.
  • Experience with databases and cloud-based application development.
  • Ability to analyze business processes and identify automation opportunities.
  • Experience translating business needs into technical requirements and solutions.
  • Strong technical ownership and independent problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to identify and recommend improvements without waiting for detailed instructions.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience building AI agents or multi-step AI workflows.
  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.
  • Experience integrating OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or other LLM platforms.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, Temporal, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with Python and TypeScript.
  • Experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, or similar full-stack technologies.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or infrastructure automation.
  • Familiarity with data engineering concepts and data pipelines.
  • Experience developing internal business tools or enterprise automation solutions.
  • Previous experience in consulting, professional services, or client-facing engineering roles.
  • Experience working in startup environments or fast-moving product teams.
  • Familiarity with AI evaluation, observability, and responsible AI development practices.

Compensation

Additional Information

Benefits & Perks:

Home office;

Competitive compensation based on experience;

Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company;

International Projects;

Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational);

Games and Competitions;

You can also apply here:

Website: https://www.oowlish.com/work-with-us/

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/oowlish/jobs/

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/oowlishtechnology/

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer, Enterprise
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a talented German speaking Senior Sales Engineer to join our Enterprise sales team. As an Enterprise Sales Engineer, you will work closely with our sales team to understand our Enterprise customers’ complex business needs and showcase how Fivetran’s data replication solutions can help them achieve their desired business outcomes. You will be responsible for providing technical expertise, identifying technical requirements, and ensuring a successful proof-of value throughout the sales cycle.

This is a full-time remote position based in Germany, with preference for Munich.

Technologies You’ll Use

AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, New Relic, Linux, Windows, Python, Java

What You’ll Do

  • Work with Enterprise customers to understand their business, their use cases, and their data replication requirements
  • Develop and deliver technical presentations to Enterprise audiences
  • Ensure the technical win by running an organized proof-of-value process
  • Work closely with multiple cross-fuctional organizations driving change and improvements to Fivetran as a whole.
  • Work closely with multiple Sales representatives, while maintaining a high level of customer focus and technical excellence
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and trends in our industry
  • Assist team members in advanced technical or business roadblocks

Skills We’re Looking For

  • Native/Professional Proficiency in German
  • 5+ years in data replication, sales engineering, or related technical field
  • Strong technical background covering database replication, cloud infrastructure, and data replication technologies with some form of hands on experience
  • Experience with modern data analytics technologies, including cloud data warehouses, transformation tooling, data catalogs, and BI tools
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with a keen ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, Postgres, MySQL, and NoSQL databases
  • Hands on experience with other data replication or ETL tools
  • Experience with self-hosted software applications and supporting infrastructure
  • Hands on networking experience both in the cloud and on-premise

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience developing partner relationships
  • Specialized expertise in security posture
  • Experience with self-hosted and SaaS software applications
  • Hands on experience with DBT
  • Docker/Podman/Kubernetes experience

jobs.title: Sr Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Dataiku is looking for a Sr. Data Platform Engineer to join our Enterprise Data and Analytics (EDA) team. As a member of the EDA Team, you will play a central role in delivering data & GenAI solutions to fuel analytics and data-driven insights to various stakeholders and teams within the company. You will be a key technical member contributing to the Data Platform that fuels centralized analytics, embedded analytics teams, and self-service users across the organization.

At this level of seniority, non-technical skills, learning & teaching, and business acumen are critical, along with the expectation of technical excellence, as you will help drive technical decision-making and solutioning of key technical challenges both within the team and across the Analytics Community. The technical day-to-day will primarily be within the Data Platform built using Snowflake, Dataiku & GitHub. The primary development will focus on GenAI Platform Capabilities, Python & SQL (among other languages), DataOps processes built within GitHub Actions & Dataiku, and data platform processes built within Snowflake & Dataiku. Strong software development lifecycle knowledge and DataOps skills are a must! The ideal candidate is naturally curious, has excellent verbal and written communication skills, has a sharp analytical mind, a positive attitude towards work and thrives when collaborating towards a shared goal. This is an internal and non-client facing role.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Be an expert-level engineer across Dataiku (Platform Automation, GenAI Capabilities, Plugin Development, maintenance & troubleshooting) and Snowflake (data engineering, security/governance), including building & maintaining GenAI Platform solutions with a security/governance focus
  • Build & maintain Python & SQL-based platform automation and DataOps processes for SDLC delivery
  • Build & maintain data quality, observability, monitoring, alerting, access management, and platform transparency systems
  • Assist Data Engineering with Python & SQL data replication & pipelines on large, complex datasets
  • Design data models (short- and long-term) to support data warehouse scalability
  • Collaborate with GenAI Engineering & Analytics Engineering to build scalable Data Platform solutions
  • Perform root cause analysis on complex errors to ensure pipeline availability
  • Help drive technical & architectural decisions on the data platform (architecture, engineering processes, data quality, security/governance frameworks, DataOps, consumption models)
  • Test new Dataiku and partner-tool features, provide feedback, and assess value for internal integration
  • Work closely with stakeholders (Infra, embedded analytics, Product, Engineering) on implementation & requirements gathering, while promoting the Data Platform internally through mentoring, innovation initiatives, and contributions to EDA team standards and best practices

Some expected outcomes for this role

  • A more secure, well-governed GenAI layer on top of the Data Platform, with clear standards for engineering delivery
  • Measurable improvements in data quality, observability, and platform reliability (fewer/faster-resolved incidents via RCA)
  • Stronger, more automated DataOps/SDLC processes reducing manual overhead across the team
  • Scalable data models that support the platform’s growth across Analytics, GenAI Engineering, and self-service users
  • Closer technical alignment between Data Platforms, GenAI Engineering, and Analytics Engineering on shared solutions

What you’ll need to be successful

  • Strong understanding of GenAI development, security & governance concepts — a must
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in Data Engineering / Data Platform Engineering / Data Architecture
  • Expert-level SQL & Python; Snowflake experience required
  • Prior experience with DevOps technologies (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins)
  • Strong understanding of data architecture & data modeling concepts
  • Prior experience building and maintaining replication & data pipelines in a cloud data warehouse or data lake environment
  • Experience working with complex stakeholders: dissecting vague asks and defining tangible requirements
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a high-trust remote environment, wearing multiple hats as needed
  • Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with a passion for continuous learning and teaching, and the ability to produce clear, precise documentation

What will make you stand out

  • Dataiku DSS experience
  • Demonstrated track record of mentoring or upskilling other engineers on new technologies or platform practices
  • Experience delivering GenAI architecture guidance directly to business/senior stakeholders

#LI-Remote

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.

jobs.title: Sr. Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are:

BigID is an innovative tech startup that focuses on solutions for data security, compliance, privacy, and AI data management. We're leading the market in all things data: helping our customers reduce risk, drive business innovation, achieve compliance, build customer trust, make better decisions, and get more value from their data.

We are building a global team passionate about innovation and next-gen technology. BigID has been recognized for:

  • BigID named one of Forbes America's Best Startup Employers 2026 - ranked #15 overall and #1 in Security
  • BigID named Hot Company in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at the Global InfoSec Awards
  • Citizens JMP Cyber 66 List of Hottest Privately Held Cybersecurity Companies
  • CRN 100 list named BigID as one of the 20 Coolest Identity Access Management and Data Protection Companies (3 years running)
  • DUNS 100 Best Tech Companies to Work for
  • Top 3 Big Data and AI Vendors to Watch in the 2023 BigDATAwire Readers and Editors Choice Awards
  • 2024 Inc. 5000 list for the 4th consecutive year!
  • Shortlisted for the 2024 AI Awards in the category of Best Use of AI in Cybersecurity

At BigID, our team is the foundation of our success. Join a people-centric culture that is fast-paced and rewarding: you’ll have the opportunity to work with some of the most talented people in the industry who value innovation, diversity, integrity, and collaboration.

About the role

As AI adoption accelerates, security, privacy, and data leaders are rethinking how they find, protect, and govern their most sensitive data. BigID is the platform many of the world’s largest organizations rely on to do it.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager for our West/Central region, you’ll own a portfolio of 10-15 large enterprise accounts and act as a trusted advisor to CISOs, privacy officers, and data and governance leaders. You’ll turn BigID’s platform into measurable business outcomes, spot risk and opportunity early, and lead cross-functional teams to deliver results. You’ll join a Customer Success team of 7, working alongside Sales, Support, Professional Services, Product, and Engineering.

What you’ll do

  • Drive measurable outcomes. Build and run success plans tied to each customer’s business goals, and standardized engagement models and playbooks so every customer gets a consistent experience as we scale.
  • Lead the customer relationship at every level. Run onboarding, adoption programs, health checks, and QBRs/EBRs, from practitioners through executives.
  • Protect the base. Track usage, executive dashboards, and health indicators to catch churn signals early, and build and run mitigation plans for at-risk accounts.
  • Grow accounts with Sales. Partner with Sales on renewals, cross-sell, and upsell, aligning BigID capabilities (data discovery, classification, privacy, security, and AI governance) to each customer’s priorities.
  • Clear the path. Orchestrate Support, Professional Services, Product, and Engineering to resolve blockers and deliver key outcomes.
  • Be the voice of the customer. Bring customer feedback and product needs to Product and Engineering, and keep customers informed on upcoming releases and enhancements.

What success looks like in your first 12 months

  • Customers in your portfolio reach their agreed success milestones, with executive-level relationships established at each key account
  • Gross and net retention at or above target, with at-risk accounts identified early and moved back to healthy
  • A qualified expansion pipeline built in partnership with Sales
  • Customer health tracked consistently and reviewed with leadership on a regular cadence

What you’ll bring

Required

  • 5+ years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or consulting, including 2+ years managing large enterprise accounts
  • Background in data security, privacy, data governance, or cybersecurity, as a customer or a vendor
  • Working knowledge of multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), on-prem, and SaaS data environments, and of structured and unstructured data
  • A record of driving adoption and managing risk to deliver renewals and expansion
  • Comfort presenting to a CISO and running an executive business review
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in complex data environments
  • Based in the West/Central US
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Nice to have

  • DSPM, DLP, or AI governance experience
  • Understanding of recurring-revenue value drivers
  • CIPP, CIPM, CISSP, or cloud certifications
  • Experience in a high-growth, scale-up environment

What’s in it for you (BigBenefits)

Our people are the foundation of our success, and we offer a wide range of benefits that help our team be happier and healthier.

  • Equity participation, so everyone shares in our success
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) participation from Day 1
  • Flexible PTO / holidays / parental leave
  • Knowledge training and career development tracks

Our values

We look for people who embody Care, Do, Try & Shine:

  • Care: We care about our customers and each other
  • Do: We do what it takes to make a positive impact
  • Try: We try our best and we don’t give up
  • Shine: We shine and make it our mission to always stand out

The annual base salary range is $120,000 to $150,000. Actual salaries vary based on a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and competencies. Salary is one component of our Compensation Philosophy. Variable/bonus compensation and equity incentives align with individual and company performance.

We’re committed to creating a culture of inclusion and equality – across race, gender, sexuality, and disability – where innovation and growth thrive, every voice is heard, and everybody belongs. Learn more about us here.

Job Candidate Privacy Notice

Must be able to exercise independent judgment with little or no oversight.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, SaaS Security Integrations
jobs.description:
About AppOmni

AppOmni is redefining SaaS security for the age of agentic security operations. As AI transforms the way security teams build, operate, and defend their environments, AppOmni is pioneering a new approach to securing the world’s most critical SaaS ecosystems.

From its roots as a leader in SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), AppOmni is driving the next evolution of SaaS security - bringing intelligence, automation, and agentic capabilities into security operations. AppOmni empowers organizations to move beyond traditional visibility and posture management toward more intelligent, proactive, and autonomous security.

Recognized as a Frost Radar™ 2025 Leader and Great Place To Work®, AppOmni continues to set the standard for innovation and customer value in SaaS security.


About the Role

This position in a rapidly growing security engineering company is an opportunity to become AppOmni's expert on how the world's most widely used enterprise SaaS platforms are configured, administered and secured. AppOmni's SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) platform connects to applications such as Microsoft 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Workday through their APIs, collects their settings and permissions, and tells customers which configurations put their data at risk.

As a Senior Engineer on the Data Platform team, you will build and maintain those integrations, and you will decide what they should look for. You know these platforms the way an experienced administrator does: which settings matter, how permissions are really granted, which APIs expose what, and where vendors change behavior between releases. You will turn that knowledge into integrations, posture checks and insights that our customers rely on. These are challenging problems in a part of the security industry without defined solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and maintain integrations with flagship enterprise SaaS platforms, including
  • Microsoft 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday and others in AppOmni's catalog.
  • Determine which configuration settings, permissions, roles and sharing models matter for security posture in each platform, and translate them into posture rules and risk logic.
  • Map each platform's admin settings to the APIs that expose them, find gaps in API coverage, and design ways to collect the data reliably.
  • Track vendor release cycles, API deprecations and new security features, and update integrations and posture content before they affect customers.
  • Define the least-privilege permissions and OAuth scopes AppOmni needs in each platform, and document why each one is required.
  • Act as the internal subject matter expert on these platforms for Product, Detection
  • Engineering, AppOmni Labs, Customer Success and Sales, and help answer complex customer questions.
  • Write clear guidance on secure configuration for each platform, for customers and for internal teams.
  • Mentor engineers on SaaS platform internals and review integration designs and code.


What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of combined experience in software engineering, application security, or SaaS platform implementation and administration.
  • Deep, hands-on administration experience with at least two of Microsoft 365 (including Entra ID), Salesforce, ServiceNow or Workday, and working familiarity with others.
  • Strong understanding of each platform's security model: identity and authentication settings, roles and permission sets, sharing and data access controls, connected apps and third-party integrations, and audit logging.
  • Experience working with SaaS platform APIs such as Microsoft Graph, Salesforce Metadata and Tooling APIs, ServiceNow Table API or Workday web services, including authentication, rate limits and pagination.
  • Professional software development experience in Python, with the ability to write production-quality, tested code.
  • Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC and SAML as used by enterprise SaaS platforms.
  • Ability to explain why a configuration is risky in terms both engineers and customer security teams understand.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.


You Might Also Have

  • Platform certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator or Platform Developer,
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Microsoft 365 or Azure security certifications or Workday Integrations or Security certifications.
  • Experience as an implementation consultant or architect for one or more of these platforms.
  • Experience with PowerShell for Microsoft 365 and Exchange administration.
  • Familiarity with security benchmarks and guidance for SaaS platforms, such as CIS
  • Benchmarks or vendor security guides.
  • Experience with Go.
  • Prior experience at an SSPM, CASB, identity security or other SaaS security vendor.
  • Experience with additional platforms such as Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, GitHub, Atlassian, Box or Zoom.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: Learn how AppOmni's integrations and posture engine work and how data flows from a SaaS platform to a customer finding. Take ownership of the integration for at least one flagship platform. Deliver a review of that platform's posture coverage, identifying missing settings and rules that should change.

The Technology You'll Work With

  • Python (Django, FastAPI, Celery) and Go
  • Microsoft Graph, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Workday APIs, and PowerShell
  • Google Cloud Platform: GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, BigQuery
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse
  • Kubernetes

Culture

Our talented team is collaborative and supportive as we move quickly to research and develop new ideas, deliver new features to our customers, and iterate on ideas and innovations. We accomplish this by focusing on our five core values: Trust, Transparency, Quality, Customer Focus, and Delivery. Our team is determined to make a difference to positively impact our way of life by securing the technology that is changing the world.

AppOmni is proud to be Certified by Great Place to WorkⓇ, as we seek to build a culture where all employees feel appreciated and supported, especially with clear and honest leadership, employee recognition, and an environment that fosters innovation and collaboration.

We believe diversity fuels innovation and drives growth by bringing a wealth of different perspectives and skills. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee feels valued, heard, and empowered to reach their full potential. Join us in building a workplace where we can all thrive.

Compensation & Benefits

AppOmni is committed to supporting our employees' financial, professional, and personal well-being. To do this, we take a holistic view of compensation, one that values not just the immediate financial package but also the long-term growth of both our employees and our company. We're committed to pay equity and transparency and encourage all candidates to discuss their salary expectations with us early in the application process.

Our total rewards package includes the following:

  • Base Salary: The annual base salary compensation range in the U.S. for this role is: $200,000 - $250,000 USD. Final offer amounts are determined by factors such as the final candidate’s location, skills, qualifications, and experience, as well as business considerations and peer compensation.
  • Stock Options: Our vision is to not just grow as a company but to grow together. By offering stock options, we are inviting you to be an integral part of our journey forward.
  • Benefits: Generous paid time off, paid company holidays, paid floating holidays, paid parental leave, paid sick time and paid family leave for applicable states, health insurance - medical, dental, and vision with HSA option, LifeWorks Employee Assistance Program, company-provided life insurance, AD&D, STD/LTD and additional supplemental life insurance options, 401(k) and Roth retirement saving accounts, and a monthly wellness benefit reimbursement. All benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and plan details.

AppOmni is an equal-opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. AppOmni is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (AI Driven) - Curveglass
jobs.description:
Curveglass is a startup incubated by AE Studio that provides a flight-level correction layer for airline revenue management, helping airlines make better decisions through advanced data science and modeling.
As part of the AE Studio ecosystem, Curveglass combines the speed, focus, and ownership of a startup with access to a broader network of engineering, AI, and product expertise.
Curveglass runs directly inside each airline's cloud environment. Our product consists of a common Core and a client-specific Adapter, which handles everything needed to make Curveglass work within each airline's environment — including the web application, APIs, data integrations, business rules, and exports into the airline's systems.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Technical Account Manager at Curveglass, you'll own the technical implementation of Curveglass for airline clients end-to-end.
This is a hands-on engineering role with broad ownership. You'll build and maintain client-specific Adapter code, work across frontend and backend systems, integrate with airline data and infrastructure, and deploy and operate Curveglass within client cloud environments.
You'll also work directly with clients. That means understanding their technical and business needs, participating in and leading meetings, troubleshooting issues, analyzing recommendation results in collaboration with revenue management teams, and managing technical expectations as needed.
You'll work closely with the Curveglass core team to determine what should be solved within a client's Adapter and what should become part of the shared Core. You'll bring client needs back to the team as roadmap input and Core change requests, while owning the implementation of client-specific functionality yourself.
We're looking for someone who enjoys the full lifecycle of software engineering: understanding the problem, building the solution, deploying it, and seeing how it performs in the real world.
You'll have meaningful ownership over the systems you build and the opportunity to influence Curveglass's architecture and product as we grow.
If you enjoy owning technical problems end-to-end and working closely with the people using what you build, we'd love to talk.

ABOUT YOU

You're a strong, pragmatic engineer who enjoys owning systems beyond just writing the code.
You're comfortable working across different parts of the stack and taking responsibility for an implementation from beginning to end: understanding requirements, designing the solution, building integrations and product functionality, deploying infrastructure, troubleshooting issues, and continuing to improve the system once it's live.
You're comfortable operating in a startup environment where problems may not always come neatly defined. You can take ownership, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and move from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production solution.
You also communicate well with people outside of engineering. You can understand the business context behind a technical request, explain technical decisions clearly, and lead conversations with clients when needed.
You work well independently, collaborate closely with data science and product teams, and care about building software that is reliable, maintainable, and genuinely useful.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong software engineering experience: You can independently design, build, debug, and maintain production systems.
  • Fluency in Python: You're highly proficient with Python and comfortable using it in production environments.
  • Full-stack development: You're comfortable working with TypeScript and React and can own frontend functionality when needed.
  • SQL and data integration: You can work confidently with relational data, APIs, client datasets, and production data flows.
  • Cloud infrastructure: You're comfortable deploying and maintaining applications in AWS or Azure.
  • Containers and infrastructure as code: You have hands-on experience with containers and tools such as Terraform.
  • End-to-end ownership: You're comfortable taking responsibility for a system across application code, integrations, infrastructure, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Client-facing communication: You're comfortable interacting directly with clients, leading technical meetings when needed, explaining decisions clearly, managing expectations, and pushing back thoughtfully when appropriate.
  • Business thinking: You care about why something is being built and the outcome it needs to create, not just the technical implementation.
  • Production-minded development: You write maintainable code and care about reliability, observability, debugging, and how systems behave in real-world environments.
  • AI-powered development: You use modern AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow and know how to use them effectively without sacrificing quality.
  • Self-management: You can take ownership of complex problems, navigate ambiguity, and deliver without constant oversight.
  • Effective communication in English: You're fluent in spoken and written English and can confidently communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Timezone flexibility: You're comfortable occasionally adapting meeting hours to work with clients across the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East.

Bonus Points for

  • Enterprise implementation experience: You've implemented enterprise or data products where customers require meaningful integration and customization rather than a purely self-service SaaS product.
  • Airline or revenue management experience: Familiarity with airline pricing, forecasting, revenue management, or related systems.
  • Data engineering experience: You've worked with production data pipelines and technologies such as Parquet, Snowflake, or similar data infrastructure.
  • Spanish or Portuguese: Professional proficiency in either language.
  • Startup experience: You thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy ambiguity, and are comfortable taking ownership beyond a narrowly defined job description.
  • Cloud deployment experience: You've deployed and operated applications or infrastructure within enterprise AWS or Azure environments.
  • Strong product instincts: You understand when something should be solved as client-specific functionality versus becoming part of a broader product.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Startup environment, backed by AE Studio: Join a focused, fast-moving startup while benefiting from the broader engineering, AI, and product ecosystem of AE Studio.
  • High-impact engineering: Build production systems that directly shape the Curveglass product and how airlines use it.
  • End-to-end responsibility: Own your work from architecture and implementation through deployment, integration, and ongoing operation.
  • Real-world problems: Work on complex engineering and data problems within airline revenue management, where the software you build directly supports business decisions.
  • Direct product exposure: Work closely with the people using what you build and bring those insights back into technical and product decisions.
  • Product influence: Help shape Curveglass's architecture, roadmap, and approach to client-specific versus shared product functionality.
  • Small, collaborative team: Work closely with engineering, data science, product, and leadership, with significant autonomy over how you solve problems.
  • Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere, or connect with the broader AE Studio team and community.
  • Flexible schedules: We care about outcomes, ownership, and impact—not micromanagement.
  • Competitive compensation: Competitive pay and the opportunity to grow alongside the company.
  • Opportunities for growth: Help shape how Curveglass approaches engineering, infrastructure, integrations, and technical decision-making as we scale.

jobs.title: Solution Architecture Manager
jobs.description:
This is an opportunity to run a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. We are rapidly expanding the range of open source solutions we offer and deliver to customers, as we move into new industries like telco, finance, health care and media we design and develop new open source solutions to meet their needs.

We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team’s direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.

We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.

The role of a Solution Architecture Manager at Canonical

The Field Engineering team is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc. The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process. 

A Solution Architecture Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.

Location: This role will be home based, managing a team in your time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers 
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

What we are looking for in you

  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • Experience in technical presales
  • You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Passion and a track record of developing and growing people
  • Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  •  An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well
  •  Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Second language - Spanish or French preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience collaborating with external partners
  • Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • 40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

 

#LI-remote

jobs.title: Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics
jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, Workflows, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.

As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.

We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.

Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hours! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.

What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations

jobs.title: Manager Security Engineer, Operations
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran + dbt is seeking a Manager of Security Operations, Incident Detection and Response, to bolster and improve the robustness and security of the platform and the entire enterprise. This people-leadership role is hands-on and execution-focused, requiring deep expertise in security operations, incident detection and response, AI-driven security automation, and securing multi-tenant SaaS environments. You'll build and lead a high-performing team, own the detection and response technology stack, and serve as the accountable leader for incident response across the entire enterprise, ensuring threats are detected, contained, and remediated quickly from endpoint to cloud to production.

This is a full-time remote position based out of the US (EST Time Zone).

Technologies You’ll Use

Crowdstrike, Okta, Google Workspace, Wiz, Open Source, Notion, JIRA

What You’ll Do

  • People Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of detection and response engineers and analysts. Set clear goals, manage performance, and grow careers while fostering a culture of ownership, curiosity, and urgency.
  • Hiring & Team Building: Recruit, hire, and onboard top security talent. Define team structure, roles, on-call rotations, and hiring plans to scale the team alongside the business.
  • Enterprise Incident Response: Own the incident response program for the entire enterprise, including investigation, containment, eradication, remediation, and post-incident review. Act as incident commander for major security events and coordinate with Legal, Privacy, Communications, and executive leadership.
  • Detection Engineering: Build, optimize, and maintain high-fidelity detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, SaaS, and application layers, using threat-informed approaches such as MITRE ATT&CK to close coverage gaps.
  • AI-Driven Security Operations: Drive the adoption of AI, including LLMs and AI agents, to automate alert triage, enrichment, investigation, and response. Evaluate and integrate AI capabilities to scale the team, and build detections for threats targeting AI systems and AI usage across the enterprise.
  • Multi-Tenant SaaS Security: Design detection and response strategies tailored to a multi-tenant SaaS platform, including tenant isolation, cross-tenant access, and customer data protection. Lead customer-impacting incident response and coordinate customer notifications.
  • Security Technology Ownership: Own the security operations technology stack, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, cloud detection and response, and log pipelines. Manage the roadmap, budget, and vendor relationships.
  • Threat Hunting & Intelligence: Lead proactive threat hunting and integrate threat intelligence to identify and mitigate emerging threats before they impact the business.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work directly with engineering, infrastructure, IT, application security, and GRC teams to integrate detection and response practices and remediate risks across build pipelines, runtime environments, and corporate systems.
  • Tooling & Automation: Develop and maintain automation, playbooks, and integrations to streamline security processes and provide self-service security tools to the organization.
  • Security Standards & Metrics: Implement consistent security controls, monitoring, and alerting across the enterprise. Define and report on key metrics such as mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to respond (MTTR), and support compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Stay up to date with trends in security operations, incident response, cloud security, and AI security, applying this knowledge to improve the Fivetran platform's security posture.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • Security Operations & Incident Response Expertise: Deep expertise in detecting, investigating, and responding to security incidents, with a track record of leading enterprise-wide incident response.
  • People Management: Proven experience managing, hiring, and developing security teams, including setting priorities, managing performance, and building a strong team culture.
  • Multi-Tenant SaaS Experience: Extensive experience securing and responding to incidents in multi-tenant SaaS environments at scale, with a strong understanding of tenant isolation and customer data protection.
  • AI Proficiency: Hands-on experience applying AI, including LLMs and AI agents, to security operations to automate detection, triage, and response, and a strong understanding of the risks AI introduces.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure Security: Strong experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes, and containerized environments, including cloud-native logging and detection.
  • Detection & Response Tooling: Proficiency with SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, identity, and cloud detection tools, and experience integrating them into automated workflows.
  • Technology Ownership: Experience owning a security technology roadmap, including tool selection, budgets, and vendor management.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to make sound decisions under pressure in fast-paced environments.
  • Communication: Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with and educate engineering teams, and to communicate clearly with executives and customers during incidents.
  • Curiosity & Urgency: Demonstrates strong curiosity, a sense of urgency, and a hands-on approach to diving deep into complex technical problems to drive timely and effective solutions.
