jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer - US Remote
jobs.description:
What is PerfectServe?

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

  1. In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
  2. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

About the role

PerfectServe is investing in a unified data platform spanning our product portfolio — the data store, the shared taxonomy, and the pipelines that will let the business answer questions across the whole platform. Our architecture team has mapped the high-level direction and target state. The detailed design is deliberately still open.

This is the senior engineering seat that takes it from direction to working platform. You will shape the detailed architecture alongside our architecture team, own the implementation and integration design, and set the engineering standards the team works to — building it with a dedicated team.

Why this role, specifically

We have done real thinking here — the high-level direction and target state are mapped, and the business case is made and funded. What is deliberately not settled is almost everything below that line. We would rather hire someone with strong opinions about it than fill it in ourselves before you arrive.

That is where the consequential decisions live — how entities resolve consistently across a broad portfolio, how time is modeled so a question about last quarter resolves against last quarter's reality, how a metric gets defined once and trusted everywhere. Cheap to get right now, expensive to correct later.

So you get a direction to work from and an architecture team to partner with, plus genuine influence over both. If you would rather bring your experience to bear on a platform while it is being built than inherit one that is already set, this is that role.

What you will do

  • Own the implementation design across the platform — ingestion, modeling, and the surfaces people consume
  • Shape the detailed architecture from the high-level direction, working with our architecture team
  • Own integration design across a varied set of production source systems
  • Build ingestion pipelines from those systems
  • Model raw data into business-ready datasets, with one agreed definition per metric
  • Set the engineering standards the team works to, including data quality and testing
  • Partner with our platform and operations teams on safe, low-impact extraction from production databases
  • Work directly with the people who need the data, so what gets built answers real questions
  • Mentor data engineers and help shape their work

What you bring

  • Substantial experience building and operating cloud data platforms, ideally including one you designed from scratch
  • Comfort making decisions with incomplete information, and the judgement to know which ones are expensive to get wrong
  • Deep SQL, and strong command of a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks or similar)
  • A transformation framework such as dbt, with clear opinions on how to structure a project
  • ELT and change-data-capture experience across relational sources
  • AWS — read replicas, object storage, and moving data between regions without surprises
  • Dimensional or medallion modeling, applied rather than theoretical
  • Workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect or similar) and data quality testing as a habit

Nice to have

  • Healthcare data, and experience handling protected health information
  • Multi-tenant data isolation
  • Semantic layer or metrics layer design
  • Modern BI and self-serve reporting tooling

Why Join PerfectServe?

At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission‑driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.

We offer a salary range of $170,000–$200,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and growth potential. This range reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. Compensation is determined by several factors, including experience, skills, and team impact. We regularly review compensation to ensure fairness and consistency. Current employees with questions are encouraged to connect with their manager or People Operations.

Benefits:

  • Remote first work environment
  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one.
  • 401K - with match and immediately vested.
  • 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy
  • Internal Advancement Opportunities

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands. We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Data Analytics team.

In this role, you’ll act as a key partner for Product, Data, and Business teams, leading measurement strategies and analytical initiatives to uncover insights that drive strategic and operational decisions.

You’ll work cross-functionally to transform complex data into clear narratives that demonstrate the value of our products and guide smarter business choices.
If you thrive on solving complex analytical problems, enjoy turning data into impactful stories, and love collaborating across teams, this role is for you!

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into business narratives.

👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

  • Progress Over Perfection: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.

jobs.title: Director, Finance Systems & ERP
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Corporate Systems Engineering builds and operates the software platforms, integrations, and automations that power Smartsheet’s core business functions across Finance, Sales/GTM, and People & Culture. Our team owns mission-critical systems and workflows that enable how the company hires, sells, bills, pays, reports, and scales. We operate at the intersection of software engineering, enterprise platforms, and business-critical data, treating internal systems with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer-facing software.

Financial Systems Engineering owns and evolves the technology ecosystem that powers Smartsheet’s financial operations and monetization capabilities. The team is responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, and supporting technologies such as Avalara, along with the integrations, data, automation, and engineering capabilities that connect these platforms across the enterprise.

As Director, Finance Systems & ERP, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for Smartsheet’s financial technology ecosystem and define the long-term technical strategy for how these platforms evolve. You will own the architecture, engineering maturity, technical health, and delivery of systems supporting core financial operations, procurement, planning, payments, billing, revenue processes, and emerging monetization models.

This is a strategic and highly visible technology leadership role. You will lead major transformation initiatives including ERP modernization, billing transformation, and the evolution toward usage-based and consumption-based monetization. You will represent Corporate Systems in executive steering committees and major transformation programs, partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Data, and other technology leaders.

You will partner closely with Product Managers across Financial Systems and Billing & Monetization to combine business and product strategy with a forward-looking technical strategy. You will be expected to challenge legacy architectures and operating models, identify opportunities to simplify and automate financial processes, and determine how modern software engineering, enterprise data, automation, and AI can improve how Finance technology operates.

You will report to the Senior Director of Corporate Systems and collaborate closely with Product and Engineering leaders across the organization.

You Will:

  • Own the technical strategy and long-term architecture for Smartsheet’s financial systems ecosystem across ERP, procurement, financial planning, payments, billing, tax, revenue processes, integrations, data, automation, and AI
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Financial Systems Engineering organization responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, Avalara, and associated technologies
  • Serve as the senior technology leader for NetSuite and ERP, ensuring the platform and surrounding architecture remain scalable, maintainable, secure, auditable, and aligned with the long-term needs of a complex SaaS business
  • Provide technology leadership for major Finance transformation programs, including ERP reimplementation and modernization, establishing architecture, engineering standards, technical governance, delivery practices, and long-term platform direction
  • Partner with Product Managers for Financial Systems and Billing & Monetization to translate product strategy and business priorities into technical roadmaps, architecture, investment decisions, and executable engineering plans
  • Shape the technology architecture required to support evolving SaaS monetization models, including subscription, multi-year, usage-based, consumption-based, and AI-related pricing and billing models
  • Partner across Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Finance, and Corporate Systems to ensure pricing and packaging strategies can be represented reliably from quote and entitlement through provisioning, usage, billing, accounting, and revenue processes
  • Establish clear architectural boundaries and systems of record across CRM, product, billing, ERP, payments, tax, planning, and downstream data platforms, reducing ambiguity, duplication, and unnecessary coupling
  • Define the strategy for Finance systems data, including authoritative sources, data models, data contracts, quality, lineage, reconciliation, historical integrity, and reliable consumption by the enterprise data platform
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to integrate Financial Systems with the enterprise data lake and ensure Finance data is timely, trustworthy, well-defined, and usable for financial reporting, operational analytics, reconciliation, and AI
  • Drive stronger data quality and observability across Quote-to-Cash and Finance workflows, moving the organization from reactive reconciliation toward proactive detection and prevention of data integrity issues
  • Establish an AI strategy for Financial Systems Engineering, identifying practical opportunities to improve engineering productivity, financial operations, controls, testing, support, reconciliation, and employee experiences
  • Evaluate and introduce AI-assisted and agentic capabilities where appropriate, while ensuring financial integrity, security, auditability, human oversight, and appropriate controls for higher-risk processes
  • Develop a strategy for automated testing and quality engineering across the Finance technology stack, including regression testing, integration testing, data validation, reconciliation, and AI-assisted test generation and analysis
  • Establish modern engineering practices across enterprise platforms, including source control, peer review, CI/CD, environment management, automated testing, observability, documentation, release engineering, and operational readiness where supported by the underlying technologies
  • Determine appropriate boundaries between native SaaS configuration, platform extensibility, APIs, integrations, automation, and custom software, avoiding unnecessary customization while enabling capabilities the business requires
  • Partner with Integration Engineering to ensure critical Finance and Quote-to-Cash integrations use scalable patterns, explicit contracts, appropriate observability, resilient error handling, and well-defined operational ownership
  • Own the technical health and lifecycle of the Financial Systems portfolio, proactively addressing architectural debt, platform limitations, fragile integrations, unnecessary customization, manual processes, and recurring operational problems
  • Establish architecture reviews, technical standards, engineering metrics, platform health reviews, and other mechanisms that continuously improve the maturity of Financial Systems Engineering
  • Represent Financial Systems Engineering on executive steering committees, transformation governance forums, and major program reviews, clearly communicating architecture decisions, delivery status, risks, dependencies, investment needs, and tradeoffs
  • Provide technical leadership across implementation partners and strategic vendors, ensuring system integrators and software providers operate within Smartsheet’s architecture, engineering, security, and delivery expectations rather than allowing vendors to define the long-term architecture
  • Partner with Finance leadership, Accounting, FP&A, Procurement, Tax, Revenue, and other stakeholders to understand business strategy while maintaining clear technology ownership of architecture and engineering decisions
  • Balance delivery of major transformation programs with operational reliability, roadmap commitments, technical debt reduction, platform modernization, security, controls, and long-term engineering investments
  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Data, Security, AI & Automation, and Corporate Systems to ensure Financial Systems operate as part of a coherent enterprise architecture
  • Recruit, develop, and retain engineering talent with a combination of Finance platform expertise, software engineering capability, systems thinking, and curiosity about the future of financial technology

You Have:

  • 10+ years of progressively responsible experience across financial systems, enterprise application engineering, ERP, software engineering, systems architecture, or related technical disciplines
  • 5+ years of experience leading technical teams, including experience managing managers, senior engineers, architects, or other technical leaders
  • Deep experience with NetSuite or comparable enterprise ERP platforms, with sufficient technical depth to lead architecture, challenge implementation decisions, and establish long-term platform strategy
  • Demonstrated experience leading a major ERP implementation, reimplementation, or transformation program from architecture and design through implementation, stabilization, and ongoing evolution
  • Strong understanding of financial business processes including record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, billing, payments, financial planning, accounting, and revenue-related workflows
  • Experience with financial platforms such as Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, Avalara, or comparable ERP, procurement, planning, payments, billing, tax, or monetization technologies
  • Experience with SaaS billing and monetization architectures, including subscription and usage-based or consumption-based business models
  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to reason across ERP, CRM, product, billing, payments, integrations, data platforms, APIs, automation, and financial controls as a connected architecture
  • Demonstrated experience defining technical strategy and architecture, rather than solely managing enterprise application delivery, configuration, implementation partners, or support
  • Experience designing or evolving enterprise data architecture, including systems of record, data models, interfaces, contracts, quality, reconciliation, governance, lineage, and downstream consumption
  • Experience partnering with enterprise Data Engineering or Analytics organizations and integrating operational systems with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar enterprise data technologies
  • Experience establishing modern engineering practices within enterprise application environments, including automated testing, CI/CD, source control, observability, release management, documentation, and operational readiness
  • Understanding of modern AI capabilities and the ability to identify practical applications of LLMs, agents, and intelligent automation while appropriately managing financial, security, and compliance risk
  • Strong understanding of financial controls, auditability, security, data integrity, and compliance considerations associated with business-critical financial platforms
  • Experience governing system integrators and technology vendors during large transformation programs, including the ability to challenge proposed architectures and hold partners accountable for engineering quality
  • Experience partnering with Product Managers and senior business leaders to combine business strategy, product strategy, and technical strategy into coherent roadmaps and investment decisions
  • Ability to operate comfortably from executive steering committee discussions to detailed architecture reviews, translating effectively between business executives, Finance leaders, Product Managers, engineers, architects, and implementation partners
  • Demonstrated ability to challenge legacy processes and architectures constructively and lead organizations through significant technology and operating-model change
  • Excellent analytical, verbal, and written communication skills, with demonstrated executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technology decisions, risks, and tradeoffs clearly
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Business, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year

In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

$175,000—$290,000 USD

Get to Know Us:

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Ads Data (AI Native)
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Ads Data Engineering team's purpose is to design, build, and maintain scalable and efficient data infrastructure that empowers Life360 teams to make data-driven decisions. We transform raw data into reliable, accessible, and actionable insights, ensuring data quality, compliance, security, costs and performance at every step. We help teams across the business unlock the full potential of their data, driving operational excellence and strategic growth. We also push the boundaries of how work gets done by adopting AI tools that accelerate our development and expand what we can deliver to stakeholders, so families get faster, more reliable experiences.

About the Job

At Life360, we collect an enormous amount of data: billions of location points, user actions, and miles driven every month, and so much more. Our analysts, ad strategists, and sales team rely on that data to run campaigns, report performance, and close deals. The core datasets and pipelines behind that work are built and in production, and the demand for new datasets, metrics, and self-serve access is growing. As a Senior Ads Data Engineer, you will own that platform on Databricks: making the existing pipelines faster, cheaper, and more reliable, and extending them as new questions come in. You will work directly with the people who use the data, and you will keep one agreed definition for each core metric so every team sees the same numbers.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $129,000 to $192,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $149,500 to $177,500 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

Primary responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Enhance, extend, and operate our existing batch and streaming pipelines and Delta Lake tables on Databricks, evolving the platform across ingestion, orchestration, storage, and serving as data volume and business needs grow.
  • Partner with business analysts, ad strategists, and the sales team to understand their questions and turn them into durable data and insights products, such as campaign performance, audience, and revenue reporting.
  • Build and maintain dbt models and tests for curated Silver/Gold datasets, and own the semantic layer and core business metrics so every team works from a single, trusted definition of performance.
  • Manage Databricks and AWS infrastructure as code with Terraform.
  • Integrate and reconcile data from ad platforms, CRM, partner feeds, and internal systems, including migrations off legacy tools and reports.
  • Implement data quality tests, monitoring, lineage, SLAs, and alerting, and define data contracts with upstream producers, leading root-cause analysis when data breaks.
  • Tune Spark and Databricks workloads for performance and cost (query plans, partitioning, shuffle and skew, cluster sizing), and make cost-aware design decisions as the platform grows.
  • Establish engineering best practices (version control, CI/CD, code review, testing, documentation), and mentor engineers and help shape the team’s technical roadmap.
  • Apply data governance, privacy, and access controls (PII, GDPR, CCPA, SOX) across the platform.
  • Enhance our LLM development support capabilities by creating tools, skills, and agents that give our LLMs more context and help us debug, build, and maintain systems faster.

Success in Year One

Within the first year, the person hired will be the go-to engineer for our foundational data models and pipelines. Pipeline runtime and compute spend will be measurably lower, and the datasets and metrics that analysts, ad strategists, and sales use will have clear owners and documented definitions. Stakeholders will answer more of their own questions without waiting on the data team, and the first set of enhancements they asked for will be in production.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering building production data platforms at enterprise scale, with demonstrated ownership of data products and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala), including partitioning and shuffle behavior, joins, skew handling, caching, and diagnosing and tuning slow or costly jobs.
  • Deep knowledge of the Databricks platform, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Jobs/Workflows, Databricks Asset Bundles, Structured Streaming, and SQL Warehouses, with proven experience optimizing workloads for performance and cost (cluster and warehouse sizing, autoscaling, Photon, serverless).
  • Strong SQL and Python (or Scala) skills for pipeline development, automation, and query optimization.
  • Hands-on production experience with dbt, including model design, testing, documentation, and incremental strategies, running on Databricks in CI/CD-driven workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform for managing cloud and data platform infrastructure as code, and with AWS (S3, IAM, and networking fundamentals as they relate to data platforms).
  • Strong experience with orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Databricks Workflows, or similar), Git, and CI/CD, and with building reliable, observable pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling (dimensional modeling, star schemas, medallion architecture) and experience building semantic layers or metric definitions.
  • Experience inheriting, refactoring, and improving existing data models and pipelines, with an eye toward reliability, maintainability, and backward compatibility for downstream consumers.
  • Experience using AI/LLM coding assistants (for example, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code), with a disciplined approach to reviewing, testing, and owning generated code rather than accepting it at face value.
  • Strong business acumen and excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements from analysts, ad strategists, and sales teams into well-designed data products and explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with data governance and compliance requirements (GDPR, CCPA, SOX) and with BI tools (Domo, Tableau, Looker, or similar).
  • Prior experience with advertising, ad tech, or media data (campaign delivery, attribution, audience, or revenue reporting) is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

AI-Native Expectations

The Ads Data Engineering team leverages LLMs to support code generation, analysis, and other use cases. Your experience with AI / LLM usage should include managing code generation with a close eye on quality, standards, and testing, while owning the outputs as your own. Your work with and ability to leverage these tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) will drive your velocity and ability to effectively work within our environment.

We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. In practice:

  • Daily use — You use AI coding assistants for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation, not just research or autocomplete.
  • Judgment and ownership — AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship.
  • Velocity — We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.
  • Team leadership — You share what works, automate prompting strategies others can build on, and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.
  • Continuous learning — The tooling changes fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Belonging

Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.

jobs.title: Staff Data Product Manager (Machine Learning) - Canada
jobs.description:
NerdWallet’s mission is to provide clarity for all of life’s financial decisions. Machine learning is how we get there at scale. It helps us understand our consumers, personalize their experiences, and connect them with the financial products that fit their needs.

We’re hiring a Staff Data Product Manager to own the ML product roadmap across NerdWallet. You’ll work with our business verticals, Data Scientists, and Engineering teams to find the highest-impact opportunities and take predictive models from idea to production to adoption. The work ranges from customer lifetime value prediction to lead scoring to personalized product recommendations.

This is a product leadership role for someone who is technically fluent in ML. You won’t build models or write production code, but you’ll be a credible, peer-level partner to the people who do. You’ll challenge assumptions on ground truth, evaluation, and serving architecture, and you’ll tie every model to a business outcome.

This role reports to the VP, Data & Analytics.

Where you can make an impact:

Partner deeply with Data Science and ML Engineering

  • Dig into modeling trade-offs, ground-truth definitions, training data quality, precision/recall, and feature strategy alongside Data Scientists and ML Engineers.

  • Navigate ML infrastructure decisions, including model serving, feature pipelines, batch vs. real-time inference, latency, and production dependencies.

  • Turn ambiguous business problems into clear model objectives, technical requirements, and measurable success criteria.

Own the roadmap and drive models into production

  • Own and prioritize the ML roadmap across verticals, balancing business impact, technical feasibility, and engineering capacity. You’ll decide what to build, defer, or say no to.

  • Work across Data Science, Data Engineering, Product Engineering, and business teams to get model predictions into consumer experiences, real-time decisioning systems, and business workflows.

  • Make sure every launch is production-ready, with clear ownership of dependencies and validated performance against technical and business requirements.

Measure what matters

  • Work with Data Science and Analytics on experiments, A/B tests, and causal measurement that prove the incremental impact of ML.

  • Define and monitor success criteria covering predictive performance, reliability, adoption, and business outcomes.

  • Explain model performance, trade-offs, limitations, and revenue impact clearly to senior stakeholders.

Lead beyond your own roadmap

  • Set the long-term vision for ML products, influence without formal authority, and mentor other product managers and partners.

Your experience:

7+ years in Data Product Management, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field, with a track record of shipping production ML or data products

  • Deep fluency in applied ML: training data, ground truth, loss functions, precision/recall, overfitting, and model evaluation

  • Strong understanding of ML platforms and infrastructure: model serving, feature pipelines, batch vs. real-time inference, latency trade-offs, and deployment workflows

  • Experience partnering directly with Data Scientists and ML Engineers to challenge assumptions and navigate complex dependencies

  • Experience with modern data and ML tools such as Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, or similar

  • Strong business sense, with the ability to connect ML work to revenue growth, customer lifetime value, conversion, and marketing efficiency

  • Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership, including influencing technical and business stakeholders without formal authority

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Where:

  • This is a remote position and a person can be located anywhere in Canada (with the exception of Quebec).

  • NerdWallet is proud to be a remote-first company! We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family.

What we offer:

Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?)

  • Monthly Healthcare Stipend

  • Rejuvenation Policy – Vacation Time Off + You will receive the official public holidays in your province

  • Paid sabbatical for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge and pursue their interests

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend, Wifi Stipend, and Cell Phone Stipend

  • Work from home equipment stipend

Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too)

  • Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities

  • Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments

  • Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction

Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people)

  • RRSP with a 4% match. Eligible one month after hire.

  • Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar

NerdWallet is committed to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, so all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (Applied ML) - Canada
jobs.description:
At NerdWallet, our mission is to provide clarity for all of life's financial decisions. Data Science plays a critical role in delivering on that mission, helping us better understand our consumers, personalize their experiences, and connect them with the financial products that best meet their needs.

We’re growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist (Applied ML) to join us as a foundational member of our new team. You’ll help shape and advance our machine learning capabilities across consumer personalization, predictive modeling, and performance marketing, with a real voice in how we work from day one. Together, we’re building an inclusive, supportive team culture where we lift each other up and succeed together to drive business impact across the organization.

In this role, you will lead the development of production-grade machine learning solutions that power some of NerdWallet's most critical business decisions. From predicting customer lifetime value and scoring incoming leads in real time to developing recommendation engines that connect consumers with the right financial products, your work will have a direct impact on how we acquire, engage, and monetize our customer relationships.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone with deep expertise in applied machine learning, production ML systems, and the Databricks ecosystem. As a foundational member of the team, you’ll partner closely with Data Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Analytics to translate complex business problems into scalable ML solutions, while helping establish the technical standards and best practices for machine learning across NerdWallet.

Where you can make an impact:

Build Predictive Models That Drive Business Growth

  • Lead the end-to-end development of advanced machine learning models focused on customer lifetime value (LTV), conversion propensity, lead quality, and revenue optimization.

  • Translate model predictions into actionable signals that improve marketing investment decisions, customer acquisition efficiency, and long-term profitability.

Advance Personalization & Recommendation Systems

  • Develop recommendation and ranking models that identify the most relevant financial products for individual consumers based on their needs, behaviors, and predicted propensity to engage or convert.

  • Explore and implement approaches such as propensity modeling, learning-to-rank, and next-best-product recommendations to improve customer engagement and cross-sell opportunities.

  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing to integrate predictive intelligence into consumer experiences and personalized communications.

Establish Best-in-Class ML Practices

  • Leverage Databricks and MLflow to develop, train, deploy, monitor, and manage machine learning models at scale.

  • Establish robust DS practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, feature engineering, automated training pipelines, model monitoring, and reproducibility.

  • Define standards for model performance, reliability, retraining, and production readiness, including monitoring for data drift and model degradation.

  • Design and evaluate experiments to measure the incremental business impact of deployed models and continuously improve their effectiveness.

  • Serve as a technical leader within Data Science, mentoring other practitioners, influencing architectural decisions, and elevating engineering and modeling standards across the organization.

Your experience:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Applied Machine Learning, or a related field, with a demonstrated track record of developing and deploying ML solutions that drive measurable business impact.

  • Deep, hands-on experience with Databricks, including building and managing production machine learning workflows using MLflow and the Databricks ML ecosystem. Please note: this role requires hands-on Databricks experience specifically, and experience with similar platforms is not a substitute.

  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with extensive experience using modern machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.

  • Strong understanding of supervised learning, predictive modeling, classification, regression, ranking, and model evaluation techniques.

  • Practical experience designing scalable batch and/or real-time inference systems, with an understanding of latency, reliability, and performance trade-offs.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including version control, testing, modular code design, and CI/CD practices for machine learning.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous technical initiatives from problem definition through deployment and business impact measurement.

  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technical solutions to measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, conversion improvement, customer lifetime value, and marketing efficiency.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing technical direction and working effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Where:

  • This is a remote position and a person can be located anywhere in Canada (with the exception of Quebec).

  • NerdWallet is proud to be a remote-first company! We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family.

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend, Wifi Stipend, and Cell Phone Stipend

jobs.title: Senior Director, Analytics and Data Science, Core Product & Growth
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Data & Analytics Team (DnA) is a 60+ person organization spanning data engineering, analytics engineering, analytics/decision science, and data science/ML. The science teams are organized into two sub teams, focusing on MAU and Revenue. This role leads decision science and data science within MAU.

You and your team will be responsible for understanding the drivers behind MAU: why members come, why they stay, and why they return. The team partners with product, marketing, and engineering to put those learnings into everyday work, and that work shapes our roadmaps.

Our data is unusual for a consumer company. Life360 measures families and circles rather than individuals, so one member's behavior affects another's, which makes measurement a different problem than a standard funnel. With billions of location events, driving behavior, crash detection, and Tile and Pet GPS trackers, we get a rich picture of physical behavior that few consumer companies can build.

About the Job

This Senior Director leads MAU Analytics and Data Science.

You and your team will work across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention on the analysis, models, and experiments behind each. A lot of what this role owns needs to be built rather than maintained: the measurement, the standards, and how the team uses AI. The team is also raising its craft, and coaching people through that is an important part of the job. Within a year, your team members will be operating at an elevated skill level, proactively bringing key questions to light, and serving as trusted advisors whom stakeholders consult for strategic guidance rather than simple task execution.

You will report to the Head of Data and work closely with counterparts leading Revenue Analytics and Data Science, and with the leaders of Data Engineering.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $247,000 to $366,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $286,000 to $339,000 CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and develop the decision scientists and data scientists on the team, and set the quality bar for both disciplines.
  • Own the MAU driver model and the forecast.
  • Own the exploratory work that drives the strategy to grow MAU.
  • Establish how an analysis gets scoped, run, reviewed, and written up, so its quality does not depend on who picked up the request.
  • Partner with your Revenue counterpart and Data Engineering leadership to define common metrics, align on experimentation standards, and introduce unified operating practices across teams.
  • Build the operating model that gets the team into the roadmap conversation early, with a view on what to build and what to test.
  • Use agents and automated analysis daily, and expect the same of the team.
  • Shape how the team works AI-native: what gets delegated to agents, what gets automated, and what stays human judgment.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 10+ years in analytics, data science, or decision science, including 5+ years in people management in a senior leadership role.
  • Deep expertise in inferential and causal analytics. Able to lead ML practitioners.
  • Expert knowledge of engagement, retention, churn, and cohort metrics.
  • Experience forecasting a company-level metric and being held to it.
  • SQL, plus Python or R.
  • Experience with Databricks, third party experimentation tools (e.g. Statsig), Tableau or similar BI tools, and AI native BI tools (e.g. Hex, AI/BI).
  • Hands-on with coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) in your own analytical work.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with experiment design to identify and control for network effects.
  • Master’s degree or PhD with an emphasis in social science, psychology or other behavioral science.
  • Experience leading a team that reports to you but sits embedded with product and engineering teams.
  • Experience in a B2C subscription business.

Core Expectations

  • You have moved an analytics team from reactive to embedded.
  • You coach and develop people, and you have grown analysts into leaders.
  • On your teams, analysis starts from a hypothesis rather than a data request.
  • You have built the standards a team works from, and got people to use them.
  • You are curious about why people behave the way they do, not just what they did.
  • You decide what the team does not work on, and you can defend it.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Life360 Values

Our company's mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it's hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don't meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Ads Data Engineering team's purpose is to design, build, and maintain scalable and efficient data infrastructure that empowers Life360 teams to make data-driven decisions. We transform raw data into reliable, accessible, and actionable insights, ensuring data quality, compliance, security, costs and performance at every step. We help teams across the business unlock the full potential of their data, driving operational excellence and strategic growth. We also push the boundaries of how work gets done by adopting AI tools that accelerate our development and expand what we can deliver to stakeholders, so families get faster, more reliable experiences.

About the Job

At Life360, we collect an enormous amount of data: billions of location points, user actions, and miles driven every month, and so much more. Our analysts, ad strategists, and sales team rely on that data to run campaigns, report performance, and close deals. The core datasets and pipelines behind that work are built and in production, and the demand for new datasets, metrics, and self-serve access is growing. As a Senior Ads Data Engineer, you will own that platform on Databricks: making the existing pipelines faster, cheaper, and more reliable, and extending them as new questions come in. You will work directly with the people who use the data, and you will keep one agreed definition for each core metric so every team sees the same numbers.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $129,000 to $192,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $149,500 to $177,500 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

Primary responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Enhance, extend, and operate our existing batch and streaming pipelines and Delta Lake tables on Databricks, evolving the platform across ingestion, orchestration, storage, and serving as data volume and business needs grow.
  • Partner with business analysts, ad strategists, and the sales team to understand their questions and turn them into durable data and insights products, such as campaign performance, audience, and revenue reporting.
  • Build and maintain dbt models and tests for curated Silver/Gold datasets, and own the semantic layer and core business metrics so every team works from a single, trusted definition of performance.
  • Manage Databricks and AWS infrastructure as code with Terraform.
  • Integrate and reconcile data from ad platforms, CRM, partner feeds, and internal systems, including migrations off legacy tools and reports.
  • Implement data quality tests, monitoring, lineage, SLAs, and alerting, and define data contracts with upstream producers, leading root-cause analysis when data breaks.
  • Tune Spark and Databricks workloads for performance and cost (query plans, partitioning, shuffle and skew, cluster sizing), and make cost-aware design decisions as the platform grows.
  • Establish engineering best practices (version control, CI/CD, code review, testing, documentation), and mentor engineers and help shape the team’s technical roadmap.
  • Apply data governance, privacy, and access controls (PII, GDPR, CCPA, SOX) across the platform.
  • Enhance our LLM development support capabilities by creating tools, skills, and agents that give our LLMs more context and help us debug, build, and maintain systems faster.

Success in Year One

Within the first year, the person hired will be the go-to engineer for our foundational data models and pipelines. Pipeline runtime and compute spend will be measurably lower, and the datasets and metrics that analysts, ad strategists, and sales use will have clear owners and documented definitions. Stakeholders will answer more of their own questions without waiting on the data team, and the first set of enhancements they asked for will be in production.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering building production data platforms at enterprise scale, with demonstrated ownership of data products and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala), including partitioning and shuffle behavior, joins, skew handling, caching, and diagnosing and tuning slow or costly jobs.
  • Deep knowledge of the Databricks platform, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Jobs/Workflows, Databricks Asset Bundles, Structured Streaming, and SQL Warehouses, with proven experience optimizing workloads for performance and cost (cluster and warehouse sizing, autoscaling, Photon, serverless).
  • Strong SQL and Python (or Scala) skills for pipeline development, automation, and query optimization.
  • Hands-on production experience with dbt, including model design, testing, documentation, and incremental strategies, running on Databricks in CI/CD-driven workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform for managing cloud and data platform infrastructure as code, and with AWS (S3, IAM, and networking fundamentals as they relate to data platforms).
  • Strong experience with orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Databricks Workflows, or similar), Git, and CI/CD, and with building reliable, observable pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling (dimensional modeling, star schemas, medallion architecture) and experience building semantic layers or metric definitions.
  • Experience inheriting, refactoring, and improving existing data models and pipelines, with an eye toward reliability, maintainability, and backward compatibility for downstream consumers.
  • Experience using AI/LLM coding assistants (for example, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code), with a disciplined approach to reviewing, testing, and owning generated code rather than accepting it at face value.
  • Strong business acumen and excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements from analysts, ad strategists, and sales teams into well-designed data products and explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with data governance and compliance requirements (GDPR, CCPA, SOX) and with BI tools (Domo, Tableau, Looker, or similar).
  • Prior experience with advertising, ad tech, or media data (campaign delivery, attribution, audience, or revenue reporting) is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

AI-Native Expectations

The Ads Data Engineering team leverages LLMs to support code generation, analysis, and other use cases. Your experience with AI / LLM usage should include managing code generation with a close eye on quality, standards, and testing, while owning the outputs as your own. Your work with and ability to leverage these tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) will drive your velocity and ability to effectively work within our environment.

We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. In practice:

  • Daily use — You use AI coding assistants for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation, not just research or autocomplete.
  • Judgment and ownership — AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship.
  • Velocity — We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.
  • Team leadership — You share what works, automate prompting strategies others can build on, and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.
  • Continuous learning — The tooling changes fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

Our Benefits

Location: Remote – South East Region (must reside in FL, GA, SC, NC, or TN)

Sigma’s vision is to create an insight-driven world where people, organizations, and, ultimately, humanity are transformed for the better by data. At Sigma, we are building a cloud-native business intelligence platform that allows users to tap into their biggest databases hosted in the cloud and easily conduct ad hoc analysis to gain business insights in seconds. All without any SQL programming. We are growing the Solution Engineering team and are looking for a Solution Engineer who will help redefine the business intelligence landscape for our customers. You will join a talented team of Solution Engineers with a shared mission to truly make data access easy to drive business results.

The Sigma Solution Engineer believes in the power of analytics to transform organizations and uncover new data insights to increase business agility. The Sigma Solution Engineer will act as the trusted advisor to our prospects and customers working in tandem with Sales, Business Development, Product Management, Engineering, and Support. This individual is ultimately responsible for managing and delivering on all activities related to the technical presales cycle. This includes presentations, demonstrations, and hands on development of prototypes. You will align closely with our field Regional Sales Managers (Enterprise) focused on sales in new and existing accounts.

  • Engage with business users to define, create, and showcase solution prototypes
  • Build and present customized demos for customers, trade shows, and webinars

  • Deliver product, technical, and security related responses on RFPs/RFIs
  • Participate in product, sales, and relevant technology certifications to acquire, maintain, and grow skill sets
  • Work as a team player by contributing, learning, and sharing new knowledge
  • Be conversant in integration and data migration approaches to facilitate enterprise-type sales cycles
  • Manage multiple customer engagements concurrently
  • Attain quarterly and annual objectives assigned by management
  • Become a Sigma champion and product expert, prospects and customers will look to you for advice and expertise

  • Minimum 5 years of business intelligence experience
  • Customer relationship skills
  • Strong understanding of database concepts
  • Cloud data warehouse experience - Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery
  • ETL experience - Fivetran, Matillion or traditional ETL
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to multitask in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Experience implementing production business intelligence solutions or proof of concepts

Trusted by data-first companies, Sigma provides live access to cloud data warehouses using an intuitive spreadsheet interface—empowering business experts to ask more of their data without writing a single line of code. With the full power of SQL, the cloud, and a familiar interface, business users have the freedom to analyze data in real time without limits. Sigma is self-service analytics as it was meant to be: a single source of truth that eliminates data extracts, simplifies analysis, and drives BI adoption at every level of business. Sigma is closing the gap between data teams and business experts. To learn more about Sigma, visit www.sigmacomputing.com or join the conversation on Twitter @SigmaComputing.

About us:

Sigma is the AI Apps and agentic analytics platform built on the cloud data warehouse. Business and technical teams use Sigma to explore live data, build intelligent applications, and automate critical workflows all without moving data or breaking governance. Sigma supports a spreadsheet interface, SQL, Python, and native AI in a single governed workspace, giving every team the speed to act and IT the control to scale. Sigma is trusted by more than 2,000 customers, including AMD, Duolingo, Colgate-Palmolive, and JPMorgan Chase.

Sigma announced its $80M in Series E financing in May 2026. The round was led by Princeville Capital, with new strategic investors Databricks Ventures, ServiceNow Ventures, and Workday Ventures participating alongside returning investors Altimeter Capital, Avenir Growth Capital, D1 Capital Partners, K5 Global, NewView Capital, Spark Capital, Sutter Hill Ventures, and XN. This milestone follows Sigma reaching $200M in annual recurring revenue in April 2026, with more than 100% year-over-year growth and 1.1 million new active users added in the latest fiscal year.

Come join us!

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Datacraft team
jobs.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.

  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Become a Senior Data Engineer for Bloomreach!

Join our newly formed Datacraft team — the team building the next-generation data platform that powers internal Databricks, the Loomi Marketing Agent with Data Insights capability for Bloomreach Marketing platform. Your engineering work will directly impact how hundreds of enterprise customers access, understand, and activate their Bloomreach data internally and with data share in Databricks and BigQuery.

The base salary range for this position at the P3 / Senior Software Engineer level is CZK 1 300 000 - CZK 1 600 000. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Working in one of our Central European offices (Bratislava, Brno or Prague) or from home on a full-time basis, you'll become a core part of the Engineering team.

What challenge awaits you?

You will join the Datacraft team as one of its founding engineers. Datacraft is a new team in the Engagement pillar, established to tackle three interconnected domains:

  • Data Warehouses (~60% of team domain) — making Bloomreach data first-class in customer Databricks. The strategic goal for 27 is to use Databricks to exponentially accelerate data adoption — both for customers who want their data outside Bloomreach and for Bloomreach itself to build analytics faster.
  • Dashboards & Analytics Stack (~20%) — moving Marketing reporting and dashboarding from the proprietary stack onto Databrick.

Datacraft is an AI-first team. We believe code is a commodity and expect every engineer to fluently use coding agents (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini CLI) as a core part of their daily workflow. The ability to leverage AI tooling to accelerate development, prototyping, and problem-solving is not optional — it's foundational. We rely heavily on knowledge graphs and spec driven development.

As a P3 (Senior) engineer at Bloomreach you are an independent professional — expert in at least one component, able to decompose objectives into tasks, and lead small projects end-to-end with minimal day-to-day guidance.

Your job will be to:

  • a. Build the Databricks data platform — Design data pipelines (Kafka → Flink -> GCS Iceberg → Databricks) following medallion architecture using Databricks notebooks and Spark Declarative Pipeline. Own data models and ETL mutations for ID resolution and consent semantics. Maintain orchestration (Airflow / Cloud Composer) and monitoring.
  • b. Co-build dashboards & analytics stack — Design canonical metrics and models on Databricks, support semantic layers and BI tools (Cube, Looker Studio), ensure tight Marketing Agent (Insights skill) integration.

Our tech stack

Python, Go, Kafka, Databricks, Airflow, Flink (Java), GCP, Mongo, Redis, Airflow, DataProc, Spark, Apache Flink, Databricks, Kubernetes, Terraform, Grafana, Prometheus, PagerDuty, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, GitLab CI/CD, Claude Code

Your success story

30 Days: Understand the Datacraft domain, complete onboarding, set up your dev environment, and get oriented on Databricks architecture and Marketing Agent.

90 Days: Ship your first pipeline, data model, or orchestration improvement to production. Join architecture discussions and the on-call rotation.

180 Days: Own a component end-to-end. Make informed trade-off decisions independently. Contribute to measurable team goals.

You have the following experience and qualities:

Professional experience

  • Solid data engineering background with strong SQL and data modeling skills (star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, partitioning/clustering, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience building production-grade data pipelines on Databricks and GCP, ideally involving Flink, Iceberg, Spark on DataProc.
  • Experience with orchestration and workflow tools — specifically Airflow / Cloud Composer — and comfort working with DAG-based systems for scheduled and event-driven jobs.
  • Familiarity with open table formats (Iceberg preferred, Delta Lake / Hudi acceptable) and how they interact with query engines and DWH platforms.
  • Strong programming skills in Python (preferred); Scala/Java/Go also relevant.
  • Good understanding of data quality, lineage, and observability (monitoring SLAs/SLOs, detecting missing/late loads, backfilling strategies).
  • Ability to work across product and engineering teams, turning fuzzy problem statements into incremental, shippable slices.

Strongly preferred

  • Background in marketing analytics, CDPs, or BI/semantic layers (Looker, dbt, Cube).
  • Experience with Snowflake or Databricks or BigQuery.
  • Experience with spec driven development, knowledge graphs, agentic harnesses or AI-powered analytics

Personal qualities

Ownership & accountability · Sharp and Product thinking · Clear communication · Bias for reliability · Continuous improvement mindset · Comfortable remote-first in Central Europe.

#LI-KP1

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

  • A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.

  • We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.

  • We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.

  • We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.

  • We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.

  • We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.

  • The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

  • We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.

  • Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*

  • Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.

  • Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

  • The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*

  • Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*

  • We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.

  • We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.

  • Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.*

Compensation:

  • Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.*

  • Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.*

  • We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!

  • We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!*

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful!

Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees.
