jobs.title: Senior Engineer, SaaS Security Integrations
jobs.description:
About AppOmni

AppOmni is redefining SaaS security for the age of agentic security operations. As AI transforms the way security teams build, operate, and defend their environments, AppOmni is pioneering a new approach to securing the world’s most critical SaaS ecosystems.

From its roots as a leader in SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), AppOmni is driving the next evolution of SaaS security - bringing intelligence, automation, and agentic capabilities into security operations. AppOmni empowers organizations to move beyond traditional visibility and posture management toward more intelligent, proactive, and autonomous security.

Recognized as a Frost Radar™ 2025 Leader and Great Place To Work®, AppOmni continues to set the standard for innovation and customer value in SaaS security.


About the Role

This position in a rapidly growing security engineering company is an opportunity to become AppOmni's expert on how the world's most widely used enterprise SaaS platforms are configured, administered and secured. AppOmni's SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) platform connects to applications such as Microsoft 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Workday through their APIs, collects their settings and permissions, and tells customers which configurations put their data at risk.

As a Senior Engineer on the Data Platform team, you will build and maintain those integrations, and you will decide what they should look for. You know these platforms the way an experienced administrator does: which settings matter, how permissions are really granted, which APIs expose what, and where vendors change behavior between releases. You will turn that knowledge into integrations, posture checks and insights that our customers rely on. These are challenging problems in a part of the security industry without defined solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and maintain integrations with flagship enterprise SaaS platforms, including
  • Microsoft 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday and others in AppOmni's catalog.
  • Determine which configuration settings, permissions, roles and sharing models matter for security posture in each platform, and translate them into posture rules and risk logic.
  • Map each platform's admin settings to the APIs that expose them, find gaps in API coverage, and design ways to collect the data reliably.
  • Track vendor release cycles, API deprecations and new security features, and update integrations and posture content before they affect customers.
  • Define the least-privilege permissions and OAuth scopes AppOmni needs in each platform, and document why each one is required.
  • Act as the internal subject matter expert on these platforms for Product, Detection
  • Engineering, AppOmni Labs, Customer Success and Sales, and help answer complex customer questions.
  • Write clear guidance on secure configuration for each platform, for customers and for internal teams.
  • Mentor engineers on SaaS platform internals and review integration designs and code.


What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of combined experience in software engineering, application security, or SaaS platform implementation and administration.
  • Deep, hands-on administration experience with at least two of Microsoft 365 (including Entra ID), Salesforce, ServiceNow or Workday, and working familiarity with others.
  • Strong understanding of each platform's security model: identity and authentication settings, roles and permission sets, sharing and data access controls, connected apps and third-party integrations, and audit logging.
  • Experience working with SaaS platform APIs such as Microsoft Graph, Salesforce Metadata and Tooling APIs, ServiceNow Table API or Workday web services, including authentication, rate limits and pagination.
  • Professional software development experience in Python, with the ability to write production-quality, tested code.
  • Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC and SAML as used by enterprise SaaS platforms.
  • Ability to explain why a configuration is risky in terms both engineers and customer security teams understand.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.


You Might Also Have

  • Platform certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator or Platform Developer,
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Microsoft 365 or Azure security certifications or Workday Integrations or Security certifications.
  • Experience as an implementation consultant or architect for one or more of these platforms.
  • Experience with PowerShell for Microsoft 365 and Exchange administration.
  • Familiarity with security benchmarks and guidance for SaaS platforms, such as CIS
  • Benchmarks or vendor security guides.
  • Experience with Go.
  • Prior experience at an SSPM, CASB, identity security or other SaaS security vendor.
  • Experience with additional platforms such as Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, GitHub, Atlassian, Box or Zoom.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: Learn how AppOmni's integrations and posture engine work and how data flows from a SaaS platform to a customer finding. Take ownership of the integration for at least one flagship platform. Deliver a review of that platform's posture coverage, identifying missing settings and rules that should change.

The Technology You'll Work With

  • Python (Django, FastAPI, Celery) and Go
  • Microsoft Graph, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Workday APIs, and PowerShell
  • Google Cloud Platform: GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, BigQuery
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse
  • Kubernetes

Culture

Our talented team is collaborative and supportive as we move quickly to research and develop new ideas, deliver new features to our customers, and iterate on ideas and innovations. We accomplish this by focusing on our five core values: Trust, Transparency, Quality, Customer Focus, and Delivery. Our team is determined to make a difference to positively impact our way of life by securing the technology that is changing the world.

AppOmni is proud to be Certified by Great Place to WorkⓇ, as we seek to build a culture where all employees feel appreciated and supported, especially with clear and honest leadership, employee recognition, and an environment that fosters innovation and collaboration.

We believe diversity fuels innovation and drives growth by bringing a wealth of different perspectives and skills. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee feels valued, heard, and empowered to reach their full potential. Join us in building a workplace where we can all thrive.

Compensation & Benefits

AppOmni is committed to supporting our employees' financial, professional, and personal well-being. To do this, we take a holistic view of compensation, one that values not just the immediate financial package but also the long-term growth of both our employees and our company. We're committed to pay equity and transparency and encourage all candidates to discuss their salary expectations with us early in the application process.

Our total rewards package includes the following:

  • Base Salary: The annual base salary compensation range in the U.S. for this role is: $200,000 - $250,000 USD. Final offer amounts are determined by factors such as the final candidate’s location, skills, qualifications, and experience, as well as business considerations and peer compensation.
  • Stock Options: Our vision is to not just grow as a company but to grow together. By offering stock options, we are inviting you to be an integral part of our journey forward.
  • Benefits: Generous paid time off, paid company holidays, paid floating holidays, paid parental leave, paid sick time and paid family leave for applicable states, health insurance - medical, dental, and vision with HSA option, LifeWorks Employee Assistance Program, company-provided life insurance, AD&D, STD/LTD and additional supplemental life insurance options, 401(k) and Roth retirement saving accounts, and a monthly wellness benefit reimbursement. All benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and plan details.

AppOmni is an equal-opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. AppOmni is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (AI Driven) - Curveglass
jobs.description:
Curveglass is a startup incubated by AE Studio that provides a flight-level correction layer for airline revenue management, helping airlines make better decisions through advanced data science and modeling.
As part of the AE Studio ecosystem, Curveglass combines the speed, focus, and ownership of a startup with access to a broader network of engineering, AI, and product expertise.
Curveglass runs directly inside each airline's cloud environment. Our product consists of a common Core and a client-specific Adapter, which handles everything needed to make Curveglass work within each airline's environment — including the web application, APIs, data integrations, business rules, and exports into the airline's systems.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Technical Account Manager at Curveglass, you'll own the technical implementation of Curveglass for airline clients end-to-end.
This is a hands-on engineering role with broad ownership. You'll build and maintain client-specific Adapter code, work across frontend and backend systems, integrate with airline data and infrastructure, and deploy and operate Curveglass within client cloud environments.
You'll also work directly with clients. That means understanding their technical and business needs, participating in and leading meetings, troubleshooting issues, analyzing recommendation results in collaboration with revenue management teams, and managing technical expectations as needed.
You'll work closely with the Curveglass core team to determine what should be solved within a client's Adapter and what should become part of the shared Core. You'll bring client needs back to the team as roadmap input and Core change requests, while owning the implementation of client-specific functionality yourself.
We're looking for someone who enjoys the full lifecycle of software engineering: understanding the problem, building the solution, deploying it, and seeing how it performs in the real world.
You'll have meaningful ownership over the systems you build and the opportunity to influence Curveglass's architecture and product as we grow.
If you enjoy owning technical problems end-to-end and working closely with the people using what you build, we'd love to talk.

ABOUT YOU

You're a strong, pragmatic engineer who enjoys owning systems beyond just writing the code.
You're comfortable working across different parts of the stack and taking responsibility for an implementation from beginning to end: understanding requirements, designing the solution, building integrations and product functionality, deploying infrastructure, troubleshooting issues, and continuing to improve the system once it's live.
You're comfortable operating in a startup environment where problems may not always come neatly defined. You can take ownership, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and move from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production solution.
You also communicate well with people outside of engineering. You can understand the business context behind a technical request, explain technical decisions clearly, and lead conversations with clients when needed.
You work well independently, collaborate closely with data science and product teams, and care about building software that is reliable, maintainable, and genuinely useful.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong software engineering experience: You can independently design, build, debug, and maintain production systems.
  • Fluency in Python: You're highly proficient with Python and comfortable using it in production environments.
  • Full-stack development: You're comfortable working with TypeScript and React and can own frontend functionality when needed.
  • SQL and data integration: You can work confidently with relational data, APIs, client datasets, and production data flows.
  • Cloud infrastructure: You're comfortable deploying and maintaining applications in AWS or Azure.
  • Containers and infrastructure as code: You have hands-on experience with containers and tools such as Terraform.
  • End-to-end ownership: You're comfortable taking responsibility for a system across application code, integrations, infrastructure, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Client-facing communication: You're comfortable interacting directly with clients, leading technical meetings when needed, explaining decisions clearly, managing expectations, and pushing back thoughtfully when appropriate.
  • Business thinking: You care about why something is being built and the outcome it needs to create, not just the technical implementation.
  • Production-minded development: You write maintainable code and care about reliability, observability, debugging, and how systems behave in real-world environments.
  • AI-powered development: You use modern AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow and know how to use them effectively without sacrificing quality.
  • Self-management: You can take ownership of complex problems, navigate ambiguity, and deliver without constant oversight.
  • Effective communication in English: You're fluent in spoken and written English and can confidently communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Timezone flexibility: You're comfortable occasionally adapting meeting hours to work with clients across the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East.

Bonus Points for

  • Enterprise implementation experience: You've implemented enterprise or data products where customers require meaningful integration and customization rather than a purely self-service SaaS product.
  • Airline or revenue management experience: Familiarity with airline pricing, forecasting, revenue management, or related systems.
  • Data engineering experience: You've worked with production data pipelines and technologies such as Parquet, Snowflake, or similar data infrastructure.
  • Spanish or Portuguese: Professional proficiency in either language.
  • Startup experience: You thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy ambiguity, and are comfortable taking ownership beyond a narrowly defined job description.
  • Cloud deployment experience: You've deployed and operated applications or infrastructure within enterprise AWS or Azure environments.
  • Strong product instincts: You understand when something should be solved as client-specific functionality versus becoming part of a broader product.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Startup environment, backed by AE Studio: Join a focused, fast-moving startup while benefiting from the broader engineering, AI, and product ecosystem of AE Studio.
  • High-impact engineering: Build production systems that directly shape the Curveglass product and how airlines use it.
  • End-to-end responsibility: Own your work from architecture and implementation through deployment, integration, and ongoing operation.
  • Real-world problems: Work on complex engineering and data problems within airline revenue management, where the software you build directly supports business decisions.
  • Direct product exposure: Work closely with the people using what you build and bring those insights back into technical and product decisions.
  • Product influence: Help shape Curveglass's architecture, roadmap, and approach to client-specific versus shared product functionality.
  • Small, collaborative team: Work closely with engineering, data science, product, and leadership, with significant autonomy over how you solve problems.
  • Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere, or connect with the broader AE Studio team and community.
  • Flexible schedules: We care about outcomes, ownership, and impact—not micromanagement.
  • Competitive compensation: Competitive pay and the opportunity to grow alongside the company.
  • Opportunities for growth: Help shape how Curveglass approaches engineering, infrastructure, integrations, and technical decision-making as we scale.

jobs.title: Customer Success Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Obsidian Security is a global leader in cyber security protecting the SaaS and non-human identity layer modern enterprises run on — from Salesforce and Snowflake to the AI agents now deployed inside them. The Obsidian Security platform gives unified visibility into every human and machine identity, app, and integration across their SaaS estate, detects identity-based and supply chain attacks in real time, and enforces least-privilege access before it's exploited. Trusted by major Fortune 500 companies T-Mobile, Workday, Snowflake, and S&P Global, Obsidian ranked No. 95 on the 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™, growing nearly 1000% from 2021–2024 — helping CISOs turn an unmonitored attack surface into one they can govern with confidence. Obsidian has also been recognized by Forbes as America's Best Startup Employers in 2026.

In August 2026, Obsidian raised $85 million in Series D financing led by Crescent Cove Advisors, with participation from existing investors including Greylock Partners, Menlo Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, IVP, Wing Ventures, and GV — pushing Obsidian's valuation to $1.1 billion, crossing into unicorn status. Obsidian is using the funding to deepen its R&D in agentic AI security and extend its platform as the standard for governing what AI agents can access and do inside third-party applications.

With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and fresh capital from its Series D behind it, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness.

About the Team

We’re building a new Service Operations function within Customer Success to modernize how we structure, access, and act on customer data. This is a foundational role: you’ll be the primary consumer of the data built and owned by Business Systems, transforming it into automated reporting and AI-assisted tools that enable customer health tracking, streamline QBRs and EBRs, and provide executives with clear visibility into customer outcomes.

About the Role

  • Own the reporting and automation layer for Customer Success — translate stakeholder needs for account health, QBR/EBR decks, and executive dashboards into field-level requirements, then build the reporting and automation on top of the Customer Success data mart.
  • Default to AI-first workflows — shape the roadmap for both deterministic (data plumbing) and non-deterministic (AI/LLM-driven) automation that surfaces customer insights, health checks, and recurring reports, replacing manual, ad hoc work wherever possible.

  • Partner across Business Systems, Product/Engineering, and Customer Success (TAM and Support) to shape how data flows into the reports and tools people use every day.

About You

  • An AI-first approach to problem-solving — you default to evaluating where agentic or LLM-driven workflows can replace manual, ad hoc reporting rather than reaching for another one-off script or dashboard.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks (or a comparable modern data platform), including querying, data modeling on governed marts, and metric/semantic views.

  • Strong communication skills — able to translate ambiguous business reporting needs into concrete data requirements.
  • Experience with Salesforce data and/or customer success platforms (e.g., Totango, Zendesk, Gainsight) is a plus.
  • Understanding of data access governance and security best practices, particularly around customer-tenant data.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity, partnering directly with engineering/business systems teams that own the broader data warehouse.
  • Experience designing or implementing automation for technical support workflows and cross-platform integrations (e.g., ticket triage, diagnostics, connecting support tools to Salesforce, Slack, or data platforms using an established integration platform) is a plus.
  • Experience with cybersecurity, SaaS security, or a technical B2B SaaS environment is a plus, but not required.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

 

New roles for Senior React Full-stack Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

 

Two ways to work with clients

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.
  • Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process.

 

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

 

What you get

  • Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills
  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.
  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.
  • No micromanagement, no screen trackers
  • Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds
  • Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries

 

Who we’re looking for

Senior Data Engineers with:

  • 4+ years of commercial experience as a Data Engineer

  • Experience with Apache Airflow and Snowflake, or Python and SQL, is required

  • Experience with AWS, GCP, or Microsoft Azure is mandatory

  • You own problems end-to-end: you spot the issue in the data or pipeline, design and build the solution, and ship it to production.

  • You can show the business impact of your work with concrete results (e.g., faster data processing, lower infrastructure costs, fresher data for stakeholders, fewer pipeline incidents).

  • Advanced English: you discuss business tasks, explain your technical decisions, raise risks early, and present yourself and your results well on client calls.

  • You work full-time remotely and deliver without supervision.
